correctness.rationale: For all m>=3,r>=4 the cell identification and radial retractions reduce to a join of r discrete m-sets with m diagonal facets removed. Explicit octahedral top cycles map onto all m relative facets, giving free top rank (m-1)^r-m and zero lower homology. The unchanged two-skeleton and the Hurewicz/Whitehead arguments prove the integral sphere wedge. Exact cubical and independent simplicial chain enumerations agree on 15 small cases, including all five tested r=4 cases.
